attachments.title: Documents
attachments.previewUnsupported: Inline preview is available for images and PDFs. Use Download for other file types.
attachments.linkSelectPlaceholder: Choose a document already in this organization…
attachments.unlinkBody: The file stays in the organization. Only this record’s link is removed.
attachments.deleteBody: The file is soft-deleted for the organization and removed from storage when possible. This cannot be undone from the product UI.
attachments.dropzone: Drop a file here, or attach a receipt or invoice. On phones, Photograph receipt or invoice opens the camera.
attachments.storageNotConfigured: File uploads are not available in this environment. Other work is unaffected.
attachments.uploadFailed: Upload did not complete. Try again.

ocr.title: Document review
ocr.description: Upload or photograph a document, edit every field, then explicitly confirm a draft expense or draft vendor bill only.
ocr.providerNotConfigured: Automatic extraction is not connected yet. Amounts will not be invented from the document.
ocr.providerConfiguredStub: Automatic extraction is not fully available yet. Amounts will not be invented from the document.
ocr.providerConfiguredPending: Extraction credentials are present, but live analysis is not ready yet. Amounts will not be invented from the document.
ocr.featureDisabled: Automatic document review is turned off. You can add an expense manually.
ocr.providerLiveReady: Extraction is connected. Review and confirm before creating a draft.
ocr.fixtureOnlyMode: Internal sample mode only — this is not real document extraction.
ocr.honesty: Fields below are suggestions only. Everything is editable before confirm. No finalized financial transaction is created automatically.
ocr.extractQueuedReview: Review and confirm before creating a draft.
ocr.extractFailed: Could not read the document ({code}). No draft was created.
ocr.offlineBlocked: Document reading needs a connection. The file was not sent.
ocr.vendorNone: No matching supplier. Choose an existing one or add a supplier first.
ocr.warnTotalsMismatch: Net plus tax does not match the total. Check before confirming.
ocr.warnLineSumMismatch: Line amounts do not match the document total.
ocr.warnDueBeforeIssue: Due date is before the document date.
ocr.warnVendorUnresolved: A supplier record is required for this draft.
ocr.mappedOnly: Preview saved. No draft was created — confirm explicitly.
ocr.rejected: Review rejected. No draft was created.
ocr.notAllowed: You do not have permission for this action.
ocr.acceptRequired: Accept at least one field before creating a draft.
ocr.vendorRequired: Select a vendor before creating a draft vendor bill.
ocr.draftTargetHint: Draft only — never a finalized posting or recognized actual cost.
ocr.sourceRetained: File details are kept. Confirm before creating a draft.
ocr.lineDescriptionsHint: Display only — copy into description if needed.
